title: Shared definitions of device enrollment, policy and check-in (fabric-device/0.1, DEC-0031)

healthState.description: Open vocabulary. Known: healthy, degraded, offline, inactive, logging_disabled, tampered, never_installed, outdated. A reader shows an unknown state as it is.

detail.$comment: Scope (CT-109): one line of free text with no path at all, so this pattern refuses the dash form after any character (my-users-list too). HOME_PATH (src/activity-rules.ts: FAC-SEM-037, FAC-SEM-040, FAC-SEM-128) refuses it only after a character that is not an ASCII letter or digit, and FAC-SEM-103 (src/proposal-rules.ts) has no dash form. Changing any of the three is a decision.
detail.description: One line of at most 200 characters with no path: no absolute path anywhere in it (a slash, backslash or tilde at the start of a word, or a drive letter), no URL-encoded slash, and no home directory in its slash or dash form (F-B-104). Never a username or content (DEC-0031).

canonicalValue.description: A value canonical JSON can sign: no fraction (write it as a string).

p256Key.description: A raw 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point (0x04 ‖ X ‖ Y), base64.

alg.description: The key's algorithm; absent means ed25519. A verifier accepts only this algorithm for this key (DEC-0053).

signingKey.description: A public key that names its algorithm: Ed25519 (raw 32 bytes, never of small order, DEC-0045) or ES256 (P-256, DEC-0053).

value.description: 64 bytes, base64: an Ed25519 signature, or an ES256 signature as r ‖ s.
